plan.goal: Users can share a schedule via a public read-only link
plan.definition_of_done: Users can share a schedule via a public read-only link: done when every acceptance criterion holds, each shown by a test or file:line
acceptance: Only the owner can create links (test)
The web share button copies the link
decisions: Tokens are opaque random strings, not JWTs (docs/adr/0007-share-tokens.md)
non_goals: No expiry UI in this job

tasks.title: Share types
done: ShareLink (token, scheduleId, expiresAt) is exported from packages/contract/src/index.ts
A type-level test fails if ShareLink loses or renames a field

tasks.title: Share endpoints
done: POST /schedules/:id/share returns 201 and an opaque token (handler_test.go)
A non-owner gets 403 and an unknown schedule 404 (handler_test.go)
GET /share/:token returns the schedule read-only; unknown or expired tokens return 404 (handler_test.go)

tasks.title: Share button
done: ShareButton copies the share link to the clipboard (test)
ShareButton shows an error message when copying fails (test)

tasks.title: Register routes and nav
done: The share routes are registered in apps/api/internal/http/routes.go (test hits them)
The web nav shows the share entry for schedule owners only (test)

open_issues: Product question: the Schedule type has a `privateNotes` field. Should the public read-only share view include it? Acceptance says 'returns the schedule read-only' without naming fields, and no decision covers it. The api task needs to know before it builds the response.
